application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Grounds of Aquarius 
T1: Cherry tree (located outside property #4) – Reduce by 0.5m back to previous points

Height of tree currently: 4m
Height of tree after reduction: 3.5m

Spread of tree currently: 3m
Spread of tree after reduction: 2.5m


T3/A/B/C/D: Hornbeam trees (x4 by footpath) – Reduce height by 2.5m through selective thinning reduce lateral growth by 1.5m through selective thinning 

Height of tree currently: 11m
Height of tree after reduction: 8.5m

Spread of tree currently: 7m
Spread of tree after reduction: 5.5m


T5: Silver birch tree (located outside property #12) – Reduce height by  2m, reduce sides by 0.5m to balance, remove major deadwood 

Height of tree currently: 11m
Height of tree after reduction: 8.5m

Spread of tree currently: 7m
Spread of tree after reduction: 6.5m


T6: Sycamore tree (outside property #13) – Reduce by 1m back to previous points, remove ivy down to fence level 

Height of tree currently: 11m
Height of tree after reduction: 10m

Spread of tree currently: 6m
Spread of tree after reduction: 5m


T7: Sycamore tree (outside property #14) – Thin canopy by 15%, remove major deadwood  

Height of tree currently: 11m
Height of tree after reduction: 11m

Spread of tree currently: 6m
Spread of tree after reduction: 6m


T8: A/B/C Sycamore trees (x3 outside properties #7 and #8) – reduce lateral growth towards the building back by 
1.5m, remove ivy up to the bottom of the gutter only

 Height of tree currently: 10m
Height of tree after reduction: 10m

Spread of tree currently: 6m
Spread of tree after reduction: 4m

T9: Fig Tree - Reduce height by  1.5m, reduce sides by 1.5m

 Height of tree currently: 4m
Height of tree after reduction: 2.5m

Spread of tree currently: 4m
Spread of tree after reduction: 2.5m

Reason for Tree Works:
General tree maintenance carried out across the grounds of Aquarius as part of the regular 3-year maintenance cycle. This includes crown reductions, crown lifting over footpaths with heavy pedestrian use, particularly routes providing access to the offices and clubs located on Eel Pie Island, and providing suitable clearance from buildings.
